mapper.sql: id, device_agent_id, event_type, occurred_at, trigger, reason_code, detail_summary, command_id, result
mapper.select: SELECT FROM device_events WHERE device_agent_id = #{deviceAgentId} AND event_type IN ('AGENT_OFFLINE_DETECTED', 'AGENT_OFFLINE_REPORTED') ORDER BY occurred_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device_events (device_agent_id, event_type, occurred_at, trigger, reason_code, detail_summary, command_id, result) VALUES (#{deviceAgentId}, #{eventType}, #{occurredAt}, #{trigger}, #{reasonCode}, #{detailSummary}, #{commandId}, #{result})
